title: Peacock reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- peacock body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#1E90FF'/>
  <!-- peacock neck -->
  <path d='M50 52 Q50 38 52 32' stroke='#1E90FF' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='28' r='9' fill='#00BFFF'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='25.5' r='1.3' fill='#00CED1'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='60,28 67,30 60,33' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <!-- crest feathers -->
  <line x1='48' y1='20' x2='46' y2='12' stroke='#1E90FF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='11' r='2' fill='#7B68EE'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='19' x2='52' y2='10' stroke='#1E90FF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='9' r='2' fill='#7B68EE'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='20' x2='58' y2='12' stroke='#1E90FF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='11' r='2' fill='#7B68EE'/>
  <!-- tail feathers (fanned behind) -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='55' rx='18' ry='7' transform='rotate(-30 30 55)' fill='#32CD32'/>
    <ellipse cx='28' cy='62' rx='20' ry='7' transform='rotate(-15 28 62)' fill='#228B22'/>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='70' rx='20' ry='7' transform='rotate(0 30 70)' fill='#32CD32'/>
    <ellipse cx='26' cy='50' rx='16' ry='6' transform='rotate(-40 26 50)' fill='#228B22'/>
    <!-- tail eyespots -->
    <circle cx='20' cy='52' r='3' fill='#FFD700'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='52' r='1.5' fill='#4169E1'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='63' r='3' fill='#FFD700'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='63' r='1.5' fill='#4169E1'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='44' r='3' fill='#FFD700'/>
    <circle cx='28' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#4169E1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='44' y1='84' x2='42' y2='94' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='84' x2='58' y2='94' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M37 94 L42 94 L47 94' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 94 L58 94 L63 94' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='38' y='56' width='28' height='20' rx='2' fill='#FF6347'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='56' x2='52' y2='76' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- book pages -->
  <rect x='40' y='58' width='11' height='16' rx='1' fill='#FFF8DC'/>
  <rect x='53' y='58' width='11' height='16' rx='1' fill='#FFF8DC'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1='42' y1='62' x2='49' y2='62' stroke='#D3D3D3' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='66' x2='49' y2='66' stroke='#D3D3D3' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='70' x2='49' y2='70' stroke='#D3D3D3' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='62' x2='62' y2='62' stroke='#D3D3D3' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='66' x2='62' y2='66' stroke='#D3D3D3' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='55' y1='70' x2='62' y2='70' stroke='#D3D3D3' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- wing holding book -->
  <path d='M38 58 Q34 64 38 72' stroke='#1E90FF' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 58 Q70 64 66 72' stroke='#1E90FF' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
